about: How the 3D mascot moves (BRD-001). The whole model moves as one: it has no rig. Every value is an offset from rest. The model is one unit tall and stands on the origin, so translateY is in mascot heights; rotations are degrees; scale is a multiplier where 1 is rest. Copied to web/src/lib/mascot3d/ and ios/Postitheka/Mascot3D/; scripts/brand-guard.sh fails when a copy differs.
